name: Expedia One Key

apr.notes: 18.49%, 23.49%, or 28.49% based on creditworthiness. Varies with Prime Rate. No penalty APR. Minimum interest charge $1.00. Late payment fee up to $40.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee for purchases converted to U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; three APR tiers suggest creditworthiness-based approval. May not be eligible if opened a One Key, One Key+, or Hotels.com Card within the last 48 months.

categories.label: Gas stations, grocery stores, and dining

rewards.redemption_notes: OneKeyCash is not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. The 3% rate on Expedia/Hotels.com/Vrbo is 1.5% base plus 1.5% bonus. Must be logged into the primary cardholder's One Key member account.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $250 in OneKeyCash after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees for purchases converted to U.S. dollars.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 cell phone protection against damage, theft, or unintended separation. $25 deductible.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for nonrefundable common carrier fare if trip is canceled or interrupted for a covered reason.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement of up to $50,000 for covered damage or theft of eligible rental vehicle.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $1,000,000 travel accident insurance when purchasing airline or common carrier tickets with the card.

benefits.title: Automatic One Key Silver Status
benefits.description: Automatic One Key Silver membership with Silver Member Prices: 15%+ savings on 10,000+ hotels. Unlock Gold status at $15,000 annual spend.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic One Key Silver status (15%+ savings on 10,000+ hotels). Gold status unlocked at $15,000 annual spend.
other: Cellular Telephone Protection up to $1,000 ($25 deductible)
Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver up to $50,000

notes: Issued by Wells Fargo. Official product page is on creditcards.wellsfargo.com (not expedia.com co-branded page). World Elite Mastercard.
